summary: Narrow re-verification of the iteration_10 bug: historical Transactions bulk-import RPC now passes p_currency from ReceiveStockForm's Multiple-mode currency dropdown. FIX VERIFIED. Uploaded /app/test_reports/artifacts/hist_ok.xlsx (1 Received + 1 Send row, dates 2024-06-15 & 2024-06-20) as admin kkwestafrique@gmail.com on actor Amina Yusuf via /transactions/received/new (Multiple mode, Conventional, currency NGN, historical toggle checked). Preview showed '2 valid row(s)'. After submit, both rows were created with status Approved: Received row at /transactions (2024-06-15 BBWBCGN2HU, Musa Ibrahim, Crude Honey 5 Kg, Currency=NGN, Total 500) and Send row at /send (2024-06-20 M1HAA37Q46, Chinedu Okafor, Beeswax-Yellow 2 Kg, Total 1,000 NGN, Approved, source batch 'Created by processing 2 Kg'). Currency propagation from form.currency into bulk_import_transaction RPC works end-to-end. issues: No explicit 'Currency' label on Send Transaction Detail (unlike Received detail which has a dedicated Currency field). Currency is only visible embedded inside 'Total amount' (e.g. '1,000 NGN'). Minor consistency nit — user can still read the currency, but the two detail layouts differ.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: useBulkUpload.submit(options) now accepts a { currency } arg and forwards it as p_currency to the RPC; ReceiveStockForm calls bulkUpload.submit({ currency: form.currency }). BulkImportContractsDialog still calls submit() with no args (correct — contracts template already includes currency per row).
Minor: the destructive 'Bulk import failed' toast in ReceiveStockForm now surfaces the RPC error message per the fix note, which resolves the second recommendation from iteration_10.
Optional follow-up (not blocking): consider adding a 'Currency' field to Send TransactionDetail for visual parity with Received detail (currently only shown embedded in Total amount).
